fields.cover_headline: Before you buy a side hustle {o:course}, read this.
fields.step1_body:
A course teaches the seller's side hustle.
Not yours. Your skills are different.
So start with what you already know.
The free Skill Finder asks the right questions.
fields.step2_body:
Or does it hand you a ready-made business?
If it never asks what you know, skip it.
Your years of work are the starting point.
Next, check who's earning from it.
fields.step3_body:
Look for students who earn from it now.
Not the seller's income screenshots.
No real students to point to? Walk away.
The last check costs you nothing.
fields.step4_heading:
Can you test it
for {o:$0} first?
fields.step4_body:
Ask Claude: how could I test this for free?
One post. One conversation. One small offer.
If it can't be tested for free, wait.
Your first test doesn't need a course.
fields.cta_subtext: Comment {o:SKILLS} and I'll DM you my free Skill Finder: 12 questions, then AI names your 3 most sellable skills.
